Special or Sensitive Data

Our website and services are not intended for children under 16 years of age without parental or guardian consent. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If you believe we have collected such data without proper consent, please contact us.

Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing

  • Processing donations and payments
  • Sending newsletters
  • Contacting users
  • Informing users of updates
  • Facilitating account creation
  • Delivering services
  • Complying with legal obligations

Data Retention

We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected or as required by law. Standard retention period: 1 year.

Sharing Data with Third Parties

We do not share your data with third parties except when necessary for service delivery or to comply with a legal obligation.

Cookies and Similar Technologies

Our website uses only essential, functional, and non-intrusive analytical cookies:

  • Remember your settings
  • Help us understand usage

Your Rights

  • Access
  • Correction
  • Deletion
  • Portability
  • Withdrawal of consent
  • Objection to processing

To exercise your rights, contact: winkel@stichting-mca.nl

Complaints

If you believe your rights have been violated, contact the Dutch DPA: autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl
pages.terms.html:
General Terms and Conditions Don KosakenChor – Marcel N. Verhoeff & Music Connects All Foundation

For visitors, users, and customers of concerts, lectures, workshops, masterclasses, the website, and the webshop

  1. Scope of Application
    1. These general terms and conditions apply to all agreements and/or legal acts between Music Connects All Foundation (acting on behalf of Don KosakenChor – Marcel N. Verhoeff) and visitors, users, and customers of events, the website, and the webshop.
    2. The latest version can always be viewed and downloaded as a PDF via the official website.
  2. Webshop and Ordering Procedure
    1. Free registration on the website is required to use the webshop.
    2. The assortment includes concert tickets, music and video recordings, books, gift items, and other products.
    3. Customers can select products and place them in a digital shopping cart. The contents may be altered or cancelled until the order is finalised. By placing an order with an obligation to pay, the customer makes a binding offer.
    4. The order amount must be paid immediately. Payment methods: credit card, direct transfer, and PayPal. In specific cases, certain payment options may be excluded.
    5. After payment, the customer receives an automatically generated confirmation email. This is not a formal acceptance. The agreement is only concluded when a separate invoice is sent.
  3. Product Availability
    1. If a product is permanently unavailable, the customer will be informed and no agreement for that product is concluded.
    2. In case of temporary unavailability, the customer will also be informed. For delays longer than two weeks after confirmation, the customer has the right to cancel the agreement.
    3. In the event of cancellation, any amount paid will be refunded as soon as possible.
  4. Tickets
    1. General
      1. It is not possible to reserve concert tickets via this website.
      2. Concert tickets are available at the concert venues where performances are held.
      3. Purchased tickets cannot be returned or exchanged. In the event of changes, an alternative will be offered where possible. There is no refund for changes or limited visibility.
  5. Prices, Delivery, and Shipping Costs
    1. Prices include VAT and apply at the time of ordering.
    2. Tickets can be collected at the office after the agreement is concluded; there are no shipping costs for tickets. Other products are shipped only.
    3. Shipping costs: within the Netherlands €3.50 per order; EU €8.00; other countries €15.00.
    4. Any additional international taxes are the responsibility of the customer.
    5. Delivery times are indicative, unless expressly stated otherwise. If a binding delivery time is exceeded, shipping costs will be refunded to the customer.
  6. Right of Withdrawal
    1. There is no right of withdrawal for concert tickets.
    2. Audio, video recordings, or software cannot be returned if the seal is broken.
    3. For other products, a right of withdrawal of 14 days after receipt applies.
    4. Exercising the right of withdrawal must be done by letter or email, optionally using a sample form.
    5. Sending the statement in time is sufficient to comply with the deadline.
  7. Consequences of Withdrawal
    1. In the event of a valid withdrawal, the purchase amount excluding shipping costs will be refunded within 14 days of notification. Return costs are borne by the customer.
    2. Refunds will be made to the same payment method, unless otherwise agreed.
    3. The product must be returned within 14 days. Refunds may be withheld until receipt or proof of shipment.
    4. In case of damage due to excessive use, compensation may be withheld.
  8. Sample Withdrawal Form

    I/we (*) hereby declare the withdrawal of the agreement concerning the purchase of the following products (*)/services (*). Ordered on (*)/received on (*) Name of consumer(s) Address of consumer(s) Date, signature (only for paper notification) (*) Delete as appropriate.

  9. Office Opening Hours
    1. Office and phone sales are available during opening hours as announced on the website.
    2. On concert days, the office is not available by phone.
  10. House Rules
    1. Visitors are bound by the regulations of the venue and must follow staff instructions.
    2. Access is denied without a valid ticket.
    3. Recording equipment may be seized, and recordings deleted if the recording ban is violated.
    4. Mobile phones and other devices with ringtone signals must be switched off.
    5. Tickets may not be offered or sold at the venue.
    6. Food and drinks are not allowed in the hall.
    7. Smoking is prohibited indoors.
    8. Animals are not permitted.
    9. In case of violation, removal from the premises may follow.
    10. In case of fire or emergency: leave the building via indicated exits and follow instructions.
    11. By purchasing tickets, the customer consents to being photographed or filmed. No rights or compensation can be derived from this.
  11. Warranty and Liability
    1. Liability for product defects is in accordance with statutory provisions.
    2. Liability is limited to damage to life, body, or health, or damage resulting from intent/gross negligence. Further liability is excluded.
    3. No liability for damage resulting from improper use.
    4. The customer must prevent and limit damage.
  12. Privacy
    1. Personal data is processed in accordance with applicable privacy legislation. See the privacy statement on the website.
  13. Applicable Law and Disputes
    1. Dutch law applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods.
    2. For non-consumers, the court in the place of establishment has jurisdiction.
    3. Invalid provisions will be replaced by statutory regulations; other provisions remain in force.
    4. The contract language is Dutch and/or English.
    5. The EU Commission offers a platform for online dispute resolution (ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr/). The organisation does not participate in dispute resolution through consumer bodies.
